title: VTG Warlock 5 No 1 and No 2 Aircel Comics Icarus Preview Sci Fi Fantasy Lot
descriptionText: The VTG Warlock 5 No 1 and No 2 Aircel Comics Icarus Preview Sci Fi Fantasy Lot features comics from the Warlock series by artist/writer Gordon Derry, focusing on a sci-fi fantasy theme. Published by Aircel Comics, these comics offer a unique and collectible glimpse into the world of US Comics, making them a valuable addition to any comic book enthusiast's collection. Dive into the imaginative and captivating stories within these vintage comic books to explore the realms of fantasy and science fiction.
